name: packaging-config
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the framework adopts a different distribution channel than a self-hosted Claude Code plugin marketplace, or when later slices fold this into a full configure/run UX feature.
spec_change_reason: Cut release v0.35.1 (patch, LIB-REFRESH — status config-presence warning): bump _PLUGIN_VERSION 0.35.0 -> 0.35.1 and regenerate the committed plugin tree so it carries scheduling 0.50.0's lib/status.py — status_data() gains config_path + local_config_present and render_status shows a loud WARNING line naming the config path (+ the shipped-defaults / no-scope-filter / aggressive-auto-merge trap) when the project-local config.json is missing or empty, or a quiet 'config <path>' confirmation when present — surfacing the wrong-anchor / unconfigured run at a glance. Only lib/status.py re-normalizes; No _LIBS change (already registered in _NORMALIZED_LIBS), no shipped default-config CONTENT change (schema unchanged), no shipped-agent change; run_tick.py/work_intake.py byte-identical to 0.35.0. The version-assertion test advanced to 0.35.1, an e2e test added asserting the committed lib/status.py carries the config-presence warning (local_config_present + config_path + render_status WARNING), test/release_lib_baseline.json re-anchored (version -> 0.35.1, lib_digest -> the new committed-lib digest), and the housekeep doc baseline re-anchored to the grown spec (480 -> 491) so the drift, #355 monotonicity, and doc-size guards stay green.
spec_no_change_reason: Spec already updated to 0.7.26 (Plugin patch v0.35.1 section) in commit ceb2972; this cycle carries the lib-refresh build regen + test/baseline re-anchor only.
